appraisal_events.evidence: « Du moins, lui c'est un homme, ce n'est pas un de ces efféminés comme on en rencontre tant aujourd'hui... Il n'est pas comme les autres, il est très gentil, très sérieux. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Charlus favorably singles out Saint-Loup from the mass of corrupt young companions, praising his manliness and seriousness, though the praise is delivered as Charlus's own qualified opinion ('à la rigueur') without independent narratorial endorsement.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Le premier sacrifice qu'il faut me faire – j'en exigerai autant que je vous ferai de dons – c'est de ne pas aller dans le monde... c'est moi qui le détiens. Je serai juge et entends rester maître de l'heure. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Charlus stages himself as gatekeeper and patron, demanding the narrator's present submission and social withdrawal in exchange for future access to Guermantes society, placing the narrator in a dependent, controlled position within this staged exchange.

status_effects.explanation: Distinguished by Charlus as a serious, manly exception among disreputable young companions, though the endorsement is qualified and self-interested.
The narrator is placed under Charlus's patronal authority, required to sacrifice his social freedom now in exchange for uncertain future favor, losing leverage in the staged exchange.
